newsitem.title: UK: UK independent TV cos agree news contract with ITN.
newsitem.headline: UK independent TV cos agree news contract with ITN.

text.p: Britain's independent television companies on Wednesday agreed a new five-year contract with Independent Television News (ITN) for the provision of national and international news.
The new contract will run from 1998 to 2002.

"This announcement marks the resolution of many key issues for ITN and assures our future as a competitive national and international news organisation," said ITN's chief executive Stewart Purvis in a statement.
